Perused the First Information Report (FIR) and related papers. The FIR has been lodged by a Police Constable on 11.06.2019. It is asserted in the FIR that the informant received an information that contraband articles namely, Gutka, Pan Masala, scented beetle nuts, etc., were being transported in a vehicle. The informant along with some poli staff, therefore, on 11.06.2019 at about 9.40 a.m., went to Purna - Palam road. On that road, they stopped a vehicle i.e. TATA make Ace, bearin registration No.MH-22-AN-1168. On enquiry, driver of the vehicle disclosed his name as Ankush Suryawanshi. The person sitting on the left side seat in the vehicle, disclosed his name as Ma Kadam. Upon inspection of the vehicle, nylon bags were found, containing contraband articles namely `Raj Niwas Gutka', `Maharaja Ki Pasand flavoured pan Masala', `GOA Gutka', etc., total wo Rs.10,82,360.
